content: A variable size array embedded in a structure which also contains a size indicator shall be serialized as the concatenation of the following ele- ments: • the length indicator which holds the length (in bytes) of the following variable size array • the array which contains the valid elements of the variable size array where • the data type of the length field shall be determined as specified in [SWS_SomeIpXf_00234] • the array shall be serialized like a static size array but does only contain the valid elements. The number of elements to serializer shall be taken from the size indicator.
